facts.fact: ZIMSTAT's Extreme Events and Disasters Report 2024, covering 2024 figures, says its statistics were compiled from administrative data of the Department of Civil Protection Unit, Environmental Management Agency, Zimbabwe National Water Authority, IOM, Police General Headquarters and the Food and Nutrition Council; road accident figures are credited to Police General Headquarters.

The report draws on police road accident records (Police General Headquarters) and on records of the Civil Protection Unit, Environmental Management Agency, Zimbabwe National Water Authority, IOM and Food and Nutrition Council.
